C: credit claimed, contested or corrected: who made it, who may claim it, which room, which name
J: success judged: by what survived, by recognizability, per project, or against the cost; criteria argued
P: the marking provisional: celebrated while building or defence went on, or 'done' reopened
E: effort and helpers recognised beyond the finished work: attempts, cleaning, a memorial list, an ordinary venue
M: machine hands named in the credit: suspected bots, scripts, bot accounts counted apart
O: the celebration post itself kept in order
